t: This is Mansion House, the official residence of the Lord Mayor of London. It's a Grade I listed building in the Palladian style, built mainly in the 1740s. It was designed by George Dance the Elder, who served as the City of London's surveyor and architect from 1735 until his death. Sir Walter Vaughan Morgan, a businessman and the five hundred and seventy-eighth Lord Mayor of London, died here in 1916.
